question: Who among the following personalities was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award (for her contribution to Manipuri Dance)?
solution:
The correct answer is ** Urmila Nagar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Renowned Manipuri Dancer:** Urmila Nagar is a renowned Indian classical dancer, specializing in Manipuri dance.
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award Recipient:** She was awarded the prestigious Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for her significant contributions to Manipuri dance.
 
• **Preserving Manipuri Tradition:** Nagar has dedicated her life to preserving and promoting Manipuri dance, both nationally and internationally.
 
• **Innovative Approach:** She has incorporated contemporary elements into Manipuri dance, while maintaining its traditional essence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nirmala Ramachandran:** Nirmala Ramachandran is a renowned Bharatanatyam dancer.
 
• **Mallika Sarabhai:** Mallika Sarabhai is a renowned classical dancer, but her primary focus is on Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi.
 
• **Kalavati Devi:** Kalavati Devi is a renowned Kathak dancer.
